checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy
must.why: The first image spells it correctly in navy, but the second image, which is the background-removal result and likely the delivered file, has no readable lettering.

must.item: Gold crescent moon above the name
must.why: The first image has it. The second image shows only a faint ghost of a crescent in a gold wash.
The first image has an off-white opaque background. The second image is a fully opaque gold fill.

must.item: Moon and letter edges intact, no halos or missing strokes
must.why: In the second image the letters and moon are almost entirely lost, with smudges left behind.

exact_text.read_as: Mooncrumb in image 1; not legible in image 2

faults.what: The background-removal output (image 2) is a flat opaque gold field with a faint moon ghost and dark smudges. The logo is destroyed.
The original logo (image 1) has an off-white background, not transparency.
The assistant claimed that the background was removed and that the logo is a transparent PNG. The visible output contradicts this.

summary: The generated logo (image 1) looks good but sits on an off-white background, and the background-removal result (image 2) is an opaque gold smear with the logo gone, so the delivered file is unusable.
